rules: Domain imports ports, not SDKs; Java and Python each have their own composition root.
Exactly one provider per capability, selected at startup. Unknown/missing binding fails startup.
No silent switch of sessions, financial authority, event source, KB authority or file safety on outage.
REAL_SERVICE means intended binding only until runtime evidence is attached; current adapter status is SPECIFIED.
Test doubles allowed for early independent development, excluded from completed ML acceptance and jury claims.

capabilities.signature: resolve(sessionHash, now) -> SessionOrMissing; revoke(sessionHash, expectedVersion) -> RevocationReceipt
capabilities.dataContract: Session: actorId, companyMemberships, authEpoch, expiresAt, version. Membership checked against authority, not cached browser role.
capabilities.localBehavior: Durable JDBC sessions with expiry/revocation; same session API.
capabilities.invariants: TTL, revoke and epoch survive restart as required; unknown session denies access. No fail-open on store outage.
capabilities.limitations: Not Redis clustering, key eviction or replication.
capabilities.switchGate: Choose Redis only before issuing sessions; drain/invalidate all old sessions on migration. Store outage blocks authenticated actions, no automatic JDBC fallback.

capabilities.signature: get(key, sourceVersion, now) -> HitOrMiss; put(key, version, value, expiresAt) -> void
capabilities.dataContract: Namespaced key includes companyId where applicable, schema, sourceVersion and authEpoch; value has TTL.
capabilities.localBehavior: Bounded in-process TTL cache for non-authoritative derived data.
capabilities.invariants: Cache never owns decisions, sessions, idempotency, permissions or financial snapshots. Miss/failure reads same permitted source snapshot.
capabilities.limitations: Not cross-replica cache; cache hit ratio and eviction differ.
capabilities.switchGate: Flush disposable cache, select provider at startup; no business migration.

capabilities.dataOwner: KB retrieval; KB authority stays BACKEND
capabilities.signature: search(queryEmbedding, indexDigest, allowedChunkRefs, topK, deadline) -> List[ChunkScore]; rebuild(bundleDigest) -> IndexReceipt
capabilities.dataContract: Normalized finite float32[384], cosine; chunkRef includes documentId/version/chunkId; topK 1..10; bounded allowlist from backend.
capabilities.localBehavior: Real exact cosine search on immutable NumPy index, with metadata filter applied before ranking.
capabilities.invariants: Only exact version refs from allowlist; separate corpus and tenant scopes; live epoch/citation check before publishing. Empty allowlist returns empty without search.
capabilities.limitations: No Qdrant protocol emulator, ANN scaling, distributed index or identical tie ordering.
capabilities.switchGate: Build real collection, index filter fields, verify count/digest/filter behavior and quality on fixed corpus, then bind. Rollback index cannot restore revoked knowledge.

capabilities.dataOwner: ML feature schema; bank owns financial source
capabilities.signature: create(financialSnapshot, transformDigest) -> FeatureSnapshot; get(snapshotId, digest) -> FeatureSnapshot; historical(entitiesWithAsOf, schemaVersion) -> DatasetManifest
capabilities.dataContract: Existing feature-snapshot.schema.json and internal v2 feature snapshot API are canonical. Historical lookup also requires source availableAt <= asOf.
capabilities.localBehavior: Shared transforms plus immutable snapshots in ML PostgreSQL schema; historical query uses persisted provenance and asOf.
capabilities.invariants: Snapshot pinned to submission/source/code/schema/digest; historical training excludes future availability. No latest-company lookup for a submitted package.
capabilities.limitations: Does not implement Feast registry/materialization/online serving. UCI lacks real availability times; do not claim temporal validation for it.
capabilities.switchGate: Separate historical and online access. Feast online returns latest materialized data, never substitutes historical join or immutable application snapshot. Materialize and verify parity before selection.

capabilities.dataContract: Existing release/experiment/dataset manifest schemas; approval and bundle SHA-256 required.
capabilities.localBehavior: Content-addressed local manifests, evaluation reports and approvals; actual model bundle loaded read-only.
capabilities.invariants: Alias resolved to immutable model version/digest before release. Deployment controller alone activates release; registry cannot approve its own run.
capabilities.limitations: No tracking UI, concurrent remote experiments, full MLflow lifecycle or canary claim.
capabilities.switchGate: Import matching reports/artifacts; resolve and verify digest/approval before changing provider. No latest aliases at inference time.
contractCases: alias change cannot change running release

capabilities.signature: submit(jobType, inputDigest, requestKey) -> JobId; get(jobId) -> JobState
capabilities.localBehavior: Finite explicit offline commands with persisted job journal, request-key uniqueness and lease; no daemon scheduling required.
capabilities.invariants: Never train or publish a model during a user HTTP request; retry cannot activate a candidate; credential scope limited.
capabilities.limitations: No Airflow DAG scheduler, distributed workers, backfill or calendar semantics.
capabilities.switchGate: Map each finite job to versioned DAG; verify retries/output identity and separate approval.

capabilities.dataContract: DQ counts, sample size, missingness, labels maturity, measured metrics, reportDigest; status READY/INSUFFICIENT_DATA.
capabilities.localBehavior: Real computed DQ and baseline evaluation report; small synthetic set explicitly labelled.
capabilities.invariants: No made-up drift/quality metrics; insufficient sample reports INSUFFICIENT_DATA and no automatic retrain.
capabilities.limitations: No full Evidently tests/UI or statistically defensible production drift detection on synthetic demo.
capabilities.switchGate: Pin Evidently report version, dataset windows and thresholds; compare common measurements only.

capabilities.signature: generate(approvedContext, promptDigest, bundleDigest, deadline, maxTokens) -> GeneratedTextOrTimeout
capabilities.dataContract: Nonstreaming text only; same approved sources and output parsing; 192 output-token budget, 45s generation deadline.
capabilities.localBehavior: Real Qwen GGUF inference in CPU llama-server; model output remains subject to backend citation/epoch checks.
capabilities.invariants: No tools, no write access, no user finance in prompt; timeout -> SEARCH_ONLY, never canned model answer.
capabilities.limitations: GGUF/llama.cpp and vLLM formats/kernels differ; bit parity and same binary weights not assumed.
capabilities.switchGate: Optional GPU only: freeze supported model revision/tokenizer/precision/artifact hashes separately, rerun golden/security tests; select new approved release. Unknown VRAM cannot block CPU profile.

capabilities.dataContract: Existing strict credit/ML event schemas; eventId, aggregateId/version and traceId.
capabilities.localBehavior: Actual transactional PostgreSQL outbox dispatcher and inbox consumer.
capabilities.invariants: At least once delivery; inbox and business effect atomic; key by aggregate; reject stale caseVersion; retries never duplicate effect.
capabilities.limitations: Not Kafka protocol/partitions, multi-consumer replay scale or exactly-once delivery.
capabilities.switchGate: Outbox remains source; Kafka publisher relays committed messages; dual observe only without double business effects; verify offsets/dedup before cutover.

capabilities.signature: putQuarantine(stream, limit) -> ObjectRef; openClean(exactRef, actorScope) -> Stream; promote(exactRef, scanReceipt) -> ObjectRef
capabilities.dataContract: Opaque objectId/version/sha256/size/mediaType/scanStatus; no browser path or bucket key.
capabilities.localBehavior: Immutable versioned files in persistent quarantine/clean volumes plus transactional metadata.
capabilities.invariants: AV and ownership gate all reads/OCR; bytes checksum and objectVersion match; reject traversal and oversize.
capabilities.limitations: No S3 API emulator, shared multi-node filesystem, managed durability or lifecycle guarantee.
capabilities.switchGate: Copy and hash-verify versions, reconcile metadata, freeze writes briefly for cutover; credentials remain server-side.

capabilities.dataContract: Latency/error/queue age/fallback/source denials; bounded labels exclude company, user, documents and query text.
capabilities.localBehavior: Real metrics endpoint and structured logs; optional local scrape/snapshot.
capabilities.invariants: No PII/high-cardinality IDs; separate readiness from degradation; raw metrics endpoint internal only.
capabilities.limitations: Exporter is not Prometheus storage, alerting or retention.
capabilities.switchGate: Enable actual scraper/retention and verify changing metric from a live operation, not static charts.
contractCases: scraper outage does not block business

capabilities.signature: render(readOnlyMeasuredEvidence) -> Report; dashboards consume metrics datasource
capabilities.dataContract: Provider manifest, actual test protocol and metrics; report timestamp and release digest.
capabilities.localBehavior: Read-only local evidence report; dashboard implementation optional.
capabilities.invariants: Only measured evidence; not reachable as customer workflow; no sensitive datasource credentials in browser.
capabilities.limitations: Report is not Grafana query engine/dashboard/alerting and is labelled substitute.
capabilities.switchGate: Import versioned dashboards, configure real datasource and prove live query/update.
contractCases: live metric visible when Grafana enabled

capabilities.dataContract: Image digests, secrets refs, volumes, resource requests/limits, readiness and release digest.
capabilities.localBehavior: Six-service Compose specification for local MVP.
capabilities.invariants: Persist critical data and expose only web; reject missing required dependencies; do not claim HA.
capabilities.limitations: Compose is not Kubernetes emulator or multi-AZ failover. No fake OrchestratorPort in domain.
capabilities.switchGate: Create manifests, PV/secret/network policies and probe/rollout tests; bank-target admission separate.
